title: Project ECHO Folded 412 People Into Oblivion | ECHO//30 Ep. 6
description:
Arvind's final recording reveals the truth behind Project ECHO: 412 people are still alive inside the missing 100 minutes—but the city has forgotten they ever existed.

Then Byte's hidden golden mechanism activates, Tara receives a devastating warning from Imran, and NULL returns carrying the faces of the erased. Its accusation changes everything the team believed about Mira and the Red Door.
